The task failed due to a formatting mismatch in the summary report where currency values lacked required comma separators.
The verifier failed in test_summary_requirements with an AssertionError because '-7,106.39' was not found in the output text. While the logic correctly calculated the values, the summary string produced '$-7106.39' instead of the expected '$-7,106.39'. Avoid omitting thousands separators in the final summary report; ensure all currency values use the f'{value:,.2f}' format to satisfy the verifier.
